PROP-56ad1eb2-inv-001.text: P256VERIFY must accept valid secp256r1 signatures and reject all invalid ones deterministically.
PROP-56ad1eb2-inv-001.assertion: forall (h,r,s,qx,qy): p256verify(h,r,s,qx,qy) == true iff ECDSA_verify(h,r,s,(qx,qy)) == true

locations.note: Delegates to external package Nethermind.Crypto.SecP256r1.VerifySignature - implementation details not in target repo
